Former nurse and midwife Helen Haines entered parliament in 2019, earning respect across the political divide for her efforts to stamp out corruption and bolster transparency. The 65-year-old was struck by a two-tonne SUV in Wangaratta on Monday afternoon.

news.title: Kenyan cult leader guilty on all charges over 191 starvation deaths
news.summary: A self-proclaimed Kenyan preacher and his associates were on Monday found guilty of murdering 190 children and one adult in an infamous starvation cult. Hundreds of bodies have been discovered since 2023 at the cult base inland from the Kenyan beach resort of Malindi, in what became known as the "Shakahola Forest Massacre".

news.title: Zelenskyy to hold talks on Russia-Ukraine war with Witkoff, Europeans
news.summary: The prime ministers of Norway and Finland will also attend the discussions in Oslo.

news.title: Indonesia continues to battle wildfires, with nearly 2 million hectares burned
news.summary: Fires in Indonesia have burned through more than 1.9 million hectares of land, according to new data, as the country battles its worst wildfire season in a decade. The blazes have sent toxic smoke across much of Southeast Asia, forcing schools to close and fuelling a rise in respiratory illnesses. FRANCE 24's Environment Editor Valerie Dekimpe tells us more.

news.title: Sailing from Britanny to Guadeloupe: Route du Rhum village opens ahead of transatlantic race
news.summary: Tuesday marked the opening of the race village in Saint-Malo for the Route du Rhum, with the first boats arriving and more expected in the coming days. A fleet of 115 boats is set to depart on November 1 for Guadeloupe in the Caribbean, as competitors prepare to take on this legendary solo sailing race across the Atlantic.

news.title: Zelensky accuses US of again failing to warn Kyiv of impending attacks
news.summary: Russia launched fresh attacks on Ukraine’s energy and civilian infrastructure this Monday. The Ukrainian president said Kyiv had once again received no advance warning of the attacks from partner countries that had previously shared intelligence. He also accused the US of deliberately delaying EU-paid weapons delivery. FRANCE 24's Gulliver Cragg reports from Ukraine.

news.title: Trump’s approval ratings plummet: what that means for the US midterms
news.summary: Sitting presidents usually see a dip in approval ratings before midterms, but Trump's ratings are at a historic low.

news.title: France first night under targeted curfews passes calmly
news.summary: France’s first night under curfew passed without incident, as authorities sought to restore order following a weekend of demonstrations that escalated into riots. The government will impose further curfews where necessary on Tuesday, Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu said. FRANCE 24 International Affairs Editor Philip Turle tells us more.

news.title: French retailers begin filing insurance claims after weekend of looting
news.summary: Shop owners in France are counting the cost of the weekend's riots as the government works on new measures to help them recover from widespread looting. Also in this edition: Germany welcomes new investments from Nvidia into its tech scene, and energy prices continue to climb after new Houthi attacks in Saudi Arabia.

news.title: Kallas acusa a EEUU de llevar año y medio presionando a Ucrania para que se rinda ante las exigencias de Putin
news.summary: La Alta Representante de la Unión Europea para Política Exterior, Kaja Kallas, ha acusado este martes a los negociadores de Estados Unidos de llevar "año y medio" intentando que Ucrania se rinda ante las exigencias del presidente ruso, Vladimir Putin, y ha defendido que Kiev no ha cedido a estas presiones gracias al apoyo que ha recibido de Europa.

news.title: France protests: Govt to impose new curfews where 'situation requires it'
news.summary: Following weekend protests and riots across the country, curfews have been imposed by the government in some parts of Paris and several cities in France. In Paris, the night passed without any disturbance as FRANCE 24's Emerald Maxwell reports. French Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu said that local authorities can decide to extend curfews if necessary.

news.title: 'Alberta mais forte em Canadá unido': província vota para seguir sendo parte do país
news.summary: Eleitores da província recusaram por ampla margem uma proposta para iniciar um processo para a independência.

news.title: Macron secures diesel deals on Gulf visit as fuel prices stoke unrest in France
news.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron has obtained commitments to deliver an additional 200,000 tonnes of diesel per month from the United Arab Emirates and Bahrain during a tour of the Gulf, his office said Tuesday as the French government scrambles to address a cost-of-living crisis that has fuelled unrest in the country.

news.title: Albertans reject referendum on independence from Canada
news.summary: Most voters in the Canadian province of Alberta have rejected a proposal to hold a referendum on independence.

news.title: The Louvre Museum blocked as France grapples with growing protests
news.summary: Dozens of students gathered outside the Louvre Museum on Monday in an attempt to block access to the iconic landmark. The movement puts pressure on the government as the Yellow Vest movement also grows. Following Saturday’s demonstrations, calls on social media for further protests on October 24 and 31 are multiplying.

news.title: South Korea to pull more embassy staff from Ukraine after POW row
news.summary: Earlier this month, South Korea recalled its ambassador from Kyiv after Zelenskyy disclosed the prisoner transfer.

news.title: Canadian opera singer replaced after he raised Palestinian flag
news.summary: Calgary’s opera house has removed a singer from future performances after he raised a Palestinian flag on stage.

news.title: 'O gado está morrendo': o impacto do El Niño na América Central
news.summary: Em faixa de terra conhecida como Corredor Seco, que atravessa cinco países, fenômeno climático agravou escassez de água e empurra milhares de famílias para uma situação de emergência e desespero.

news.title: Out of control? France stunned by October 17 rioting
news.summary: France didn't just erupt on Saturday – it exploded. Police were doubly overwhelmed by the turnout of the October 17 cost-of-living demonstrations, which saw two and-a-half times the crowds they expected. Officers were also overwhelmed by determined flashmobs: some radical militants hellbent on a fight, others who came for the looting. The whole world watched the assault on symbols of the Republic like the 19th-century city hall in Limoges, the usually quiet porcelain capital of France.

news.title: Why US investors are snapping up Germany's famed Mittelstand
news.summary: Increasing amounts of US capital are flowing into Germany's traditional industrial firms and family-owned businesses. As many business owners struggle to find successors, more companies are becoming acquisition targets.

news.title: Díaz-Canel tacha de "patético circo miamense" la orden de detención de EEUU contra el expresidente Raúl Castro
news.summary: El presidente de Cuba, Miguel Díaz-Canel, ha denunciado la orden de detención emitida por un tribunal de Florida, en Estados Unidos, contra el expresidente Raúl Castro como un "patético circo miamense", asegurando que tiene un telón de fondo "electoral" y que no tiene "el más mínimo sentido jurídico ni práctico".

news.title: Why Israeli Gen Z voters are drawn to the far right
news.summary: More than half a million young people will cast their ballots in Israel next week - and they could make all the difference.

news.title: French protests: Is it game over for Macron’s centrists before elections?
news.summary: The protests have further polarised the French and turned the youth into a key, angry, voting bloc.

news.title: Noruega acoge hoy una reunión entre Zelenski y enviados de Trump sobre una propuesta diplomática en Ucrania
news.summary: EEUU detalla que los trabajos se centran en "dos vías paralelas" sobre "el futuro de Ucrania" y "condiciones para una paz duradera"

news.title: UEFA demands FIFA release key documents on World Cup sell-off plan
news.summary: In a letter outlining 42 questions, UEFA gives FIFA until November 2 to release documents on Infantino’s aborted plans.

news.title: France protests are ‘outburst of resentment’ against Macron
news.summary: French student union spokesperson Alice Cohen-Morzadec says the protests reflect growing anger over Macron's policies.

news.title: Padre morre ao ser atingido por crucifixo em missa transmitida ao vivo
news.summary: Padre Patricio Sánchez Molinari, de 53 anos, estava no altar conduzindo a celebração quando o grande crucifixo de madeira preso à parede atrás dele se desprendeu e caiu diretamente sobre ele em igreja de Guayaquil.

news.title: Lecornu destaca que los toques de queda contribuyeron a "una calma" en Francia y adelanta que serán nuevamente impuestos
news.summary: El primer ministro de Francia, Sebastian Lecornu, ha destacado este martes que los toques de queda "localizados" han contribuido a "una calma" durante la última noche y ha adelantado que en las próximas horas se establecerán de nuevo estas medidas "allí donde la situación lo requiera" de cara a la próxima noche.

news.title: Michiko Kodama, superviviente de Hiroshima: "Tenemos fe en que España firme el tratado para prohibir armas nucleares"
news.summary: Michiko Kodama, superviviente del bombardeo atómico de Hiroshima y secretaria general adjunta de la ONG Nihon Hidankyo, galardonada con el premio Nobel de la Paz en 2024, ha expresado su optimismo ante la posibilidad de que España se desmarque de la principal postura de sus aliados y se adhiera el Tratado sobre la Prohibición de Armas Nucleares (TPAN) a pesar de estar bajo el paraguas nuclear de Estados Unidos.

news.title: Alberta voters reject separation from Canada, early results show
news.summary: With more than one million votes counted, about 76 percent supported remaining in Canada.

news.title: French cities calm overnight after curfews imposed to quell violence, PM says
news.summary: Sébastien Lecornu said new curfews for Tuesday night would be decided where necessary.

news.title: US-Ukraine relations sour as Trump, Zelenskyy clash over talks, arms
news.summary: Trump calls for Zelenskyy to be replaced as negotiator, while Ukraine's president says arms shipments delayed.

news.title: Palestine weekly: Israeli settlers attack journalist and diplomats
news.summary: Settler olive harvest attacks top 2025 total, journalist and diplomats attacked as Israel halts Gaza commercial imports.

news.title: Egypt’s Hassan and Zico suspended over FIFA World Cup refereeing criticism
news.summary: FIFA punishes Egypt's head coach, forward and team manager for their comments after their World Cup loss to Argentina.

news.title: Southeast Asia’s haze crisis will persist until polluters pay
news.summary: Cheap land clearing imposes costs across borders. ASEAN must change the incentives that keep the fires burning.

news.title: Canada: Alberta rejects separation bid, CBC projects
news.summary: Voters have decisively rejected a proposal to begin the legal process toward Alberta's independence, dealing a major blow to a movement driven largely by economic grievances.

news.title: Al menos ocho muertos en ataques del Ejército de Rusia sobre varias localidades de Ucrania
news.summary: Las autoridades ucranianas han informado este martes de la muerte de al menos ocho personas, además de varios heridos más, como consecuencia de los ataques del Ejército ruso sobre diferentes ciudades del país, incluida la capital, Kiev.

news.title: Al menos tres muertos y seis heridos en un ataque ruso contra instalaciones industriales en la región de Kiev, Ucrania
news.summary: Al menos tres personas han muerto y otras seis han resultado heridas esta madrugada como consecuencia de un nuevo ataque perpetrado por las fuerzas rusas contra un edificio de producción y almacenaje en la región ucraniana de Kiev, según ha informado el Servicio Estatal de Emergencias de Ucrania.

news.title: Irán convoca al embajador de Alemania en represalia por las acusaciones de espionaje
news.summary: El Ministerio de Asuntos Exteriores de Irán ha convocado al embajador de Alemania en Teherán, Axel Dittmann, para trasladarle su protesta por las recientes acusaciones vertidas por altos cargos germanos, una medida que responde directamente a la convocatoria horas antes del representante iraní en Berlín a raíz de una condena judicial por espionaje en favor de la República Islámica.

news.title: Alberta voters reject a move toward independence in referendum backing Canadian unity
news.summary: Voters in Canada's oil-rich Alberta province overwhelmingly backed remaining in Canada, with early referendum results Tuesday delivering a boost to Prime Minister Carney's push for national unity.

news.title: Australian MP seriously hurt in suspected car attack
news.summary: Helen Haines, an independent federal lawmaker, suffered severe injuries in what Australia's prime minister has called a deliberate attack by a man in a car.

news.title: Israel’s elections 2026 explained in maps and charts
news.summary: Israelis vote on October 27 in the sixth election since 2019. Here’s how the system works and who gets left out.

news.title: La diputada australiana Helen Haines, en estado crítico, pierde una pierna tras ser atropellada de manera intencionada
news.summary: La diputada independiente australiana Helen Haines continúa en estado crítico y ha perdido una pierna tras ser atropellada de manera intencionada por un vehículo a las puertas de su oficina electoral en la ciudad de Wangaratta, en el estado de Victoria.

news.title: US Supreme Court to hear case on race in school admissions
news.summary: A group of parents claims local admission policy boosts Black and Latino students while constraining Asian applicants.

news.title: JD Vance prevé el apoyo de Trump si se presenta a la Presidencia en 2028 y se desmarca del apoyo electoral a Netanyahu
news.summary: El vicepresidente de Estados Unidos, JD Vance, ha expresado su confianza en que obtendría el respaldo "de inmediato" del presidente Donald Trump si finalmente decide presentar su candidatura a la Casa Blanca en las elecciones de 2028, al tiempo que se ha desmarcado del reciente apoyo por parte de Trump al primer ministro israelí, Benjamin Netanyahu, que aspira a ser reelegido en el cargo en las próximas elecciones en Israel, que se celebrarán el 27 de octubre.

news.title: Japan launches historic mission to bring back Mars moon samples
news.summary: Japan has launched a five-year uncrewed mission to collect samples from Phobos, one of Mars’ two moons.
